modelAssumptions: Both fleet sizes are prospective sensitivity scenarios, neither selected or attributed to XBF or a carrier; keep the same3.7functional full-equivalents to show scale impact, not certified workload capacity.

All payroll in this alternative uses US national private-industry ECEC occupation groups. Do not transplant US benefits to MX staff, geographically adjust wages without evidence, or add the separate Mexican monitor salary/contribution model.

Use published total compensation per hour worked times explicitly declared worked hours and role quantities; do not add wages, paid leave, FICA/FUTA/SUTA/workers compensation or benefit insurance again.

Seven functional quantities are distinct allocations of592worked hours/month, not proof of seven hires, a feasible roster or continuous human coverage. The same individual's hours must not be duplicated across roles when a real roster is later supplied.

One monthly payroll pool and one TMS license pool are conserved across all pairs first, then two tractor cost centres by equal power-unit count. Box payroll share is explicitly excluded from this driver, not an unknown box-administration expense assumed zero.

TMS named account count is seven despite fractional role hours; subscriptions/licenses are one cost identity, not two canonical-field charges. No free trial, bulk discount or extra load-board membership used.
All other company concepts, including office/yard/mobile/professional services, remain outside these components, not free. No whole admin-and-company budget family is filled by this model.
Reference monthOctober2026 uses June2026 survey rates as a prospective proxy without an invented inflation factor; no guarantee of observed October prices or BLS sample confidence for this scenario.
